title: Hot chocolate / cocoa, dry mix, made with low‑fat (1 %) or fat‑free (skim) milk

content.title: About
content.content: The dry mix for hot chocolate/cocoa is designed to be prepared with low‑fat (1 %) or completely fat‑free (skim) milk. The blend contains cocoa powder, sugar and emulsifiers, delivering a rich chocolate flavor without added fat.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix dissolves quickly in hot milk, creating a smooth, lump‑free beverage.
Cocoa powder is usually gently processed to retain most of its antioxidants.
Low‑fat milk provides most of the calcium and protein while keeping saturated fat to a minimum.
The product is widely used in cafés and cafeterias for fast preparation of hot drinks.
Some versions include vanilla or a pinch of sea salt to enhance flavor.

items.title: Rich in antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa is high in flavonoids, which help combat free radicals and support cardiovascular health.

items.title: Low in saturated fat
items.content: Preparing the drink with low‑fat milk keeps saturated fat intake low, which is beneficial for weight management.

items.title: Source of magnesium and potassium
items.content: Both the cocoa mix and milk supply magnesium and potassium, essential for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Mood‑boosting compounds
items.content: Cocoa contains phenylethylamine, which may improve mood and increase alertness.

items.title: Provides protein
items.content: Skim milk adds high‑quality protein to the beverage, supporting tissue repair and satiety.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: People with lactose intolerance or a cow‑milk protein allergy should choose a dairy‑free alternative.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The mix often contains added sugar; individuals monitoring blood glucose should watch portion size.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Cocoa contains modest amounts of theobromine, which can affect sleep if consumed in large quantities.

items.title: Oxalates
items.content: Cocoa contains oxalates that may contribute to kidney stone formation in susceptible individuals.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Combine 2–3 tablespoons of the dry mix with 250 ml of hot (but not boiling) low‑fat or skim milk. Stir vigorously with a whisk or blend until fully dissolved. Optionally add a pinch of salt or a dash of vanilla extract.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Check the package for the best‑by date; after opening, use within 3–6 months for optimal quality.
